import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 6.29

by O. V. Mel'nikov

Suppose that a finite group $A$ is isomorphic to the group of all topological
automorphisms of a locally compact group $G$. Does there always exist a discrete
group whose automorphism group is isomorphic to $A$? This is true if $A$ is
cyclic; the condition of local compactness of $G$ is essential (R. J. Wille,
*Indag. Math.*, **25**, no. 2 (1963), 218–224).

Here a topological automorphism of a topological group $G$ is a group
automorphism of $G$ that is also a homeomorphism, i.e. a term of `G ≃ₜ* G`. As
usual in this context, topological groups are assumed to be Hausdorff. Since a
discrete group is just an abstract group, "the automorphism group of a discrete
group $H$" is `MulAut H`.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«6.29»

section TopologicalAutomorphismGroup

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]

/-- The group of all topological automorphisms of a topological group `G`: the
bicontinuous group automorphisms `G ≃ₜ* G`, with the group operation given by
composition. As for `MulAut`, `f * g` is `g` followed by `f`. -/
instance instGroupContinuousMulEquiv : Group (G ≃ₜ* G) where
  mul f g := g.trans f
  one := ContinuousMulEquiv.refl G
  inv := ContinuousMulEquiv.symm
  mul_assoc _ _ _ := rfl
  one_mul _ := rfl
  mul_one _ := rfl
  inv_mul_cancel f := ContinuousMulEquiv.ext f.symm_apply_apply

@[category API, AMS 20 22]
theorem mul_apply (f g : G ≃ₜ* G) (x : G) : (f * g) x = f (g x) :=
  rfl

@[category API, AMS 20 22]
theorem one_apply (x : G) : (1 : G ≃ₜ* G) x = x :=
  rfl

@[category API, AMS 20 22]
theorem inv_apply (f : G ≃ₜ* G) (x : G) : f⁻¹ x = f.symm x :=
  rfl

/-- The topological automorphism group of a discrete group is its abstract
automorphism group, so the question is trivial when $G$ is discrete. -/
@[category test, AMS 20 22]
theorem nonempty_mulAut_mulEquiv_of_discreteTopology [DiscreteTopology G] :
    Nonempty (MulAut G ≃* (G ≃ₜ* G)) :=
  ⟨{ toFun f := { f with
        continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology
        continuous_invFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology }
     invFun f := f.toMulEquiv
     left_inv _ := rfl
     right_inv _ := rfl
     map_mul' _ _ := rfl }⟩

end TopologicalAutomorphismGroup

/--
Suppose that a finite group $A$ is isomorphic to the group of all topological
automorphisms of a locally compact (Hausdorff) group $G$. Does there always
exist a discrete group whose automorphism group is isomorphic to $A$?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20 22]
theorem kourovka.«6.29» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∀ (A : Type) [Group A] [Finite A]
      (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
      [LocallyCompactSpace G],
      Nonempty (A ≃* (G ≃ₜ* G)) →
      ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Group H), Nonempty (MulAut H ≃* A) := by
  sorry

/--
The question has a positive answer when $A$ is cyclic: if a finite cyclic group
$A$ is isomorphic to the group of all topological automorphisms of a locally
compact (Hausdorff) group $G$, then there is a discrete group whose automorphism
group is isomorphic to $A$.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 20 22]
theorem kourovka.«6.29».variants.cyclic :
    ∀ (A : Type) [Group A] [Finite A] [IsCyclic A]
      (G : Type) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
      [LocallyCompactSpace G],
      Nonempty (A ≃* (G ≃ₜ* G)) →
      ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Group H), Nonempty (MulAut H ≃* A) := by
  sorry

/--
The condition of local compactness of $G$ is essential (R. J. Wille, 1963):
there is a Hausdorff topological group $G$, not locally compact, whose group of
all topological automorphisms is finite but is not isomorphic to the
automorphism group of any discrete group.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 20 22]
theorem kourovka.«6.29».variants.local_compactness_essential :
    ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : TopologicalSpace G),
      IsTopologicalGroup G ∧ T2Space G ∧ ¬ LocallyCompactSpace G ∧
      Finite (G ≃ₜ* G) ∧
      ¬ ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Group H), Nonempty (MulAut H ≃* (G ≃ₜ* G)) := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«6.29»
